source: Génère un jeu de Tycoon de concessionnaire automobile en monde ouvert 3D en route libre inspiré des standards Roblox, où le joueur commence avec un capital de départ partiel et un véhicule en 3D classique pour gagner de l'argent à un rythme équilibré, et intègre un immense concessionnaire avec un grand garage souterrain ainsi qu'une boutique pour progresser.

image_prompt.text: The boutique attached to the dealership - the storefront the player keeps returning to in order to progress
Drivable circulation chaining the dealership to the rest of the map and down into the garage
Open wide roads across the map for free driving, sized so vehicle meshes turn without clipping
An immense car dealership with a glass showroom displaying vehicles
A large underground garage beneath the dealership with rows of parking bays, reached by a ramp

layout_placement.text: A spawn point beside the dealership holding the player's starting classic car

notes: No preset was taken. The Tycoon preset assumes a shared build plot, which contradicts an open world with one dealership, and the only preset carrying the surface-and-underground shape is an extraction bundle with ore fields and hauling routes. Options were picked directly instead.
P2 and P3 both come from the shape: the garage sits under the surface map and is entered from outside.
Starting capital, the earning rate and the shop's upgrades are economy tuning with no spatial footprint.

open_questions.ask: No theme was stated - modern glass-and-steel dealership district, or something more stylized?
How much drivable world around the dealership - a few streets, or a full open map?
Is the free-roam world a real city with other destinations, or just roads around the dealership?

coverage_missing.ask: What should the dealership and its surroundings look like?
How big is the drivable world?
Does the player buy and resell cars, or run the dealership as a business with staff and customers?

answers.ask: No theme was stated - modern glass-and-steel dealership district, or something more stylized?
answers.answer: Choisissez un quartier de concessionnaire moderne en verre et acier, dans un style Roblox propre et accessible.

answers.ask: How much drivable world around the dealership - a few streets, or a full open map?
answers.answer: Prévoyez une petite carte ouverte avec quelques rues praticables autour du concessionnaire, afin de garder une première version compacte et jouable.

answers.ask: Is the free-roam world a real city with other destinations, or just roads around the dealership?
answers.answer: Le monde libre doit se limiter aux routes autour du concessionnaire ; aucun autre lieu ni destination n’est demandé dans le prompt.
